title: The Future You're Actually Inheriting
assessmentMethod: Private reflective journal entry, not scored

body.en: Ghana's young people will spend more of their working lives dealing with climate change than any generation before them — hotter cities, less predictable farming seasons, and entire industries reshaping around the shift to green energy and low-carbon growth. That can sound overwhelming, or it can sound like the moment to get positioned early, while the shape of the green economy is still being decided rather than already fixed. What's one skill, interest, or idea you have that could matter more, not less, in a climate-changed economy?
